{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify that we now have one row per patient
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f"Expected 800 patients, got {len(df_dedup)}"

# Convert assay_batch B values from µg/L to ng/mL: divide by 10
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_ng_ml'] = df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Check that no -999 values remain in biomarker_final
missing_final_count_after = (df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_final after conversion: {missing_final_count_after}")

# Compute the mean
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ng_ml'].mean()
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
